currentWholeGoal.title: Entwicklungsstrategien bewerten
currentWholeGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Strategien wie Importsubstitution oder Exportorientierung vergleichen.
currentWholeGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can compare strategies such as import substitution and export orientation.

resourceLinks.title: Visualisierung: Entwicklungsstrategien bewerten
resourceLinks.altText: Binnenproduktion und Export stehen als zwei mögliche Entwicklungsstrategien nebeneinander. Menschen vergleichen gemeinsame Bedingungen und offene Risiken.

currentWholePRecord.reason: DE: Eigener inaktiver Profilentwurf aus dem ganzen aktuellen Ziel und der echten EN-Übersetzung. Inhaltliche Kernunterscheidung: Importsubstitution fördert heimischen Ersatz zuvor importierter Produkte; Exportorientierung zielt auf ausländischen Absatz. Beide Strategien brauchen Fähigkeiten, Inputs, Marktgröße und Institutionen und können kombiniert werden. Schutz ist kein garantierter Lernfortschritt und Exportwachstum kein vollständiger Entwicklungsbeweis. Die konkreten Fälle sind didaktische Erwartungen, keine beobachtete Lernendenleistung, unabhängige Prüfung oder menschliche Freigabe. EN: Own inert profile draft based on the whole current goal and its actual English translation. Core distinction: Import substitution supports domestic replacements for imports; export orientation targets foreign demand. Both need capabilities, inputs, markets and institutions and can be combined. Protection does not guarantee learning, and export growth does not establish comprehensive development. The specific cases are didactic expectations, not observed learner performance, independent review, or human approval.

expectations.essentialUnderstandingDe: Importsubstitution fördert heimischen Ersatz zuvor importierter Produkte; Exportorientierung zielt auf ausländischen Absatz. Beide Strategien brauchen Fähigkeiten, Inputs, Marktgröße und Institutionen und können kombiniert werden. Schutz ist kein garantierter Lernfortschritt und Exportwachstum kein vollständiger Entwicklungsbeweis.
expectations.essentialUnderstandingEn: Import substitution supports domestic replacements for imports; export orientation targets foreign demand. Both need capabilities, inputs, markets and institutions and can be combined. Protection does not guarantee learning, and export growth does not establish comprehensive development.
expectations.observablePerformanceDe: Die Person vergleicht neue Importsubstitutions- und Exportstrategien anhand gleicher konkreter Bedingungen, erklärt Mechanismen, Chancen und Grenzen und begründet einen bedingten Vergleich.
expectations.observablePerformanceEn: The learner compares new import-substitution and export strategies under common specific conditions, explains mechanisms, opportunities and limits, and justifies a conditional comparison.

variationAxes.textEn: Domestic import replacement or foreign demand.

variationAxes.textDe: Marktgröße, Inputs, Fähigkeiten, Transport und Schutzkontrolle.
variationAxes.textEn: Market size, inputs, skills, transport and protection oversight.

applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandDe: Ein fiktives Land vergleicht zeitlich begrenzten Schutz lokaler Maschinenfertigung mit exportorientierter Teileproduktion. Material gibt kleinen Binnenmarkt, Lernpotenzial, importierte Inputs und Kontrollregeln. Vergleiche.
applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandEn: A fictional country compares temporary protection of local machinery production with export-oriented parts production. Materials give a small domestic market, learning potential, imported inputs and monitoring rules. Compare.
applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceDe: Die Person erklärt Ersatzimport/Lernen gegenüber Auslandsskalen/Absatz, prüft Inputkosten, Marktgröße und Schutzbefristung und nennt Abhängigkeits-/Effizienzrisiken beider Wege. Sie setzt Schutz nicht mit Autarkie oder jeden Export mit hohem heimischem Mehrwert gleich.
applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceEn: The learner explains import replacement and learning versus foreign scale and sales, examines input costs, market size and temporary protection, and identifies dependency/efficiency risks in both. They equate neither protection with autarky nor all exports with high domestic value added.

applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandDe: Ein anderes fiktives Land kann lokale Lebensmittelimporte durch Verarbeitung ersetzen oder spezialisierte Produkte exportieren. Material nennt Inlandsernährung, Qualität, Transport, Weltpreisschwankung und Weiterbildung. Vergleiche mögliche Kombinationen.
applicationCaseBriefs.taskDemandEn: Another fictional country can replace food imports through processing or export specialised products. Materials give domestic food access, quality, transport, world-price volatility and training. Compare possible combinations.
applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceDe: Die Person vergleicht Versorgung, Wertschöpfung, Anforderungen und Risiko nach gemeinsamen Kriterien und erklärt eine begründete Kombination oder Priorität unter den Daten. Sie unterscheidet steigenden Exportabsatz von sicherem Zugang zu heimischer Grundversorgung.
applicationCaseBriefs.expectedPerformanceEn: The learner compares food access, value added, requirements and risks through common criteria and explains a justified combination or priority under the data. They distinguish export growth from secure domestic basic access.
applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusDe: Strategien wirken über konkrete Produktions- und Versorgungsbedingungen.
applicationCaseBriefs.understandingFocusEn: Strategies operate through specific production and access conditions.

laterActualA04REVISE.currentDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Strategien wie Importsubstitution oder Exportorientierung vergleichen.
laterActualA04REVISE.currentDescriptionEn: The learner can compare strategies such as import substitution and export orientation.

understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingDe: Importersatz und Exportorientierung nutzen andere Absatzkanäle, brauchen aber Fähigkeiten, Inputs und tragfähige Märkte.
understandingEvidence.essentialUnderstandingEn: Import replacement and export orientation use different sales channels but require capabilities, inputs and viable markets.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceDe: Die Person bewertet beide Strategien vergleichend nach gemeinsamen Bedingungen und belegbaren Wirkungswegen.
understandingEvidence.observablePerformanceEn: The learner comparatively assesses both strategies through common conditions and supportable mechanisms.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationDe: Bei kleinem Binnenmarkt und importierten Vorprodukten begründet sie Grenzen zeitweisen Schutzes und mögliche Kombinationen.
understandingEvidence.transferExpectationEn: With a small domestic market and imported inputs, they justify limits of temporary protection and possible combinations.

laterActualA04REVISE.rationale: Titel und AB3-Kontext beanspruchen Bewertung, während beide Beschreibungen beim Vergleichen enden. Die Revision macht die bereits behauptete bedingte Bewertung sichtbar. Binnenproduktion/Export und Bedingungen im Bild sowie der ganze P tragen dieselben Mechanismen und Grenzen; keine neue Strategiefamilie.
laterActualA04REVISE.proposedDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Strategien wie Importsubstitution und Exportorientierung anhand ihrer Wirkungsmechanismen, Bedingungen und Grenzen vergleichend bewerten.
laterActualA04REVISE.proposedDescriptionEn: The learner can comparatively assess strategies such as import substitution and export orientation through their mechanisms, conditions and limits.

earlierOwnerActualRationale: Der konkrete Vergleich Importsubstitution/Exportorientierung bleibt in beiden Sprachen vollständig und bedingt. Der Titel bewerten erzwingt keine neue unbegrenzte Urteilsquote über den tatsächlichen Vergleichsoperator hinaus. Beide tatsächlichen unabhängigen D-Runden sind KEEP und das native Buch enthält P=null/create. Die getrennte schon vollständig vonRoot geprüfte P-v2-Lane bleibt E1/G1/ai_candidate/needs_human_review; keine menschliche Freigabe oder beobachtete Lernleistung.

localPrimaryReadings.finding: Official Q4.3 discusses development strategies among approaches to reduce global inequality; it names Polarisierungs-/Abkopplungs-/Grundbedürfnisstrategie, not the exact snapshot import-substitution/export-orientation sentence. Q4.1 additionally calls for analysis/assessment and derivation of recommendations. The source extraction marks this exact sentence sourceSnapshotGoal, not officialCompetency. Thus neither the compare operator nor AB3 in that HE seed is itself a verbatim official requirement.

eA/LK development-policy methods explain measures; world-economy judgment column expressly requires criterion-oriented discussion of future prospects of emerging/developing economies. Operator comparison in AFBII asks for criterion-oriented similarities/differences; AFBIII judgment/discussion additionally asks for justified factual/value judgment. This supports a bounded justified strategy assessment, not a requirement to claim every strategy comparison is necessarily AFBIII.

LK IF8 separately calls for analysis of globalization effects and judgment of effects on differently developed countries, including winners/losers; assessment of free-trade/protectionist positions is another relevant aspect. Existing 27 upper-secondary mappings to this atom are broad partial unions; they do not individually establish exact import-substitution/export-orientation performance or allow widening GK into the LK-tagged atom.

primaryExtractionLimitations: Local pypdf layout extraction warned about rotated text elsewhere in documents; the read named development/operator pages were actually inspected as extracted pages. No web fetch or current-law claim; no PDF/full extraction copied into repository. Missing pdftotext and two shape assumptions stopped diagnostic helpers before recommendation; no artifact or review success was inferred from those failed attempts.

existingForeignQualifiedPracticeMaterial.limitedUse: Whole existing tasks/solutions/scoring actually read only to identify the assessed contract; valid foreign whole-science reuse, no new material review or body modification. A2 requires monitoring/priority/combination with a failure scenario; B2 requires a budget/capacity-feasible justified priority/combination and access/maintenance/evaluation. Rubric allocates actual conditional choice/feasible strategy marks. This is bounded assessment already operationalized.

performanceComparison.currentDescriptionLiteral: Criterion-based comparison alone can list mechanisms, common conditions, opportunities and limits without deciding which conditions make a policy feasible/appropriate. It underspecifies the justified strategy assessment advertised by the title and materially expected in the second originalP case and current foreign-qualified whole exercise.
performanceComparison.caseAOriginalP: The whole expected performance weighs imported-input costs, small-market scale, learning assumptions, temporary protection and dependencies; a justified conditional assessment can conclude neither policy is automatically preferable. No unconditional winner, permanent protection or autonomous production claim required.
performanceComparison.caseBOriginalP: The whole expected performance expressly requires a justified combination or priority under supply, quality, transport, world-price and training conditions. A pure two-column similarities/differences list does not supply that conditional conclusion.
performanceComparison.concreteAnalysisOnlyCounterexample: Import replacement sells domestically and exports abroad. Import replacement may support local learning but has higher input/user costs; exports may yield scale but depend on buyers/transport. In the food case domestic supply differs from export revenues and world-price risk. This correct common-criteria comparison still gives no justified feasibility/priority/combination judgment; it can satisfy the current literal compare sentence while missing the already expected bounded conclusion.
performanceComparison.fairSufficientAlternatives: A justified provisional supply-first approach with monitored training and a conditional later export share can qualify; so can a justified export priority under reliable transport with explicit access protection, buyer diversification and tested capability assumptions. Acknowledging unresolved evidence and limiting conclusions is correct. No predefined winner, complete ideal criteria list, fixed answer order or extra task quota.

recommendation.disposition: Description clarification after M6 checkpoint; do not lower title, demandLevel, source/course/role or profile strength. Not an immediate canonical edit.
recommendation.suggestedDescriptionDe: Die lernende Person kann Strategien wie Importsubstitution und Exportorientierung anhand gemeinsamer Kriterien, ihrer Wirkungsmechanismen, Bedingungen und Grenzen vergleichend beurteilen.
recommendation.suggestedDescriptionEn: The learner can comparatively assess strategies such as import substitution and export orientation using common criteria and their mechanisms, conditions and limits.
recommendation.scope: The same strategy comparison and conditional judgment under material-bound criteria. No new strategy family, ideal ranking, blanket development guarantee or unrelated universal norm/value judgment.
recommendation.whyPreferThisToTitleCompare: Changing only title to compare would align the bare old HE snapshot but would hide the bounded judgment already concretely required by the original P second case/current whole exercise and the relevant NI/NW judgment context. Local AB3 alone cannot decide the operator; the whole performance evidence supports the clarification.
recommendation.agreementAndLimitOfA04: The A04 semantic mismatch is substantiated; its description-clarification direction is reasonable. Its bare title+AB3 premise is insufficient as source proof. Common criteria plus a bounded justified conclusion explains the actual existing performance, rather than raising an arbitrary assessment quota.
